articles.title: Gonzalez, a Killeen councilwoman, wins Democratic JP primary runoff
articles.excerpt: profilesummary: 'Gonzalez won the May 26, 2026 Democratic runoff over LaTasha Quarles, 51.3% to 48.7% (1,233 to 1,171 votes, unofficial results per the Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: JP for Killeen Quarles Gonzalez Head to Runoff Election as Incumbent Finishes 3rd
articles.excerpt: James, finished third in the March primary (KDH).

articles.title: Gonzalez Says Her Time and Service Will Get Her Edge in November JP Race
articles.excerpt: Gonzalez is Killeen's District 1 council member and mayor pro tem; she has said she would immediately resign from council if elected (KDH).

articles.title: Cox and Gonzalez Participate in Justice of the Peace Forum ahead of Nov Election
articles.excerpt: She faces Republican Beatrice "Bea" Cox on the Nov. 3 ballot (KDH; [Nov. 3 ballot guide](/nov-3-2026-ballot-guide/)).

articles.title: Recall Petition Submitted for Mayor Pro Tem Gonzalez Awaits Verification
articles.excerpt: In July 2024, a recall petition against Gonzalez was submitted by Killeen residents, as reported by the Killeen Daily Herald (petition submitted).

articles.title: Removal Effort Against Killeen Mayor Pro Tem Falls Short Due to Lack of Qualified Signatures
articles.excerpt: The city said the petition fell short because it lacked enough qualified signatures from District 1; 246 were required (city finding, KDH).
